description: Policyholders (customers) who own one or more housing insurance policies. One row per owner.

columns.name: owner_id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the policy owner (format OWN####). Primary key; referenced by policy_coverage.owner_id.

columns.name: date_of_birth
columns.description: Owner's date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD). Used for age-based underwriting and identity verification.

columns.name: address
columns.description: Owner's mailing street address. May differ from the insured property address.

columns.name: city
columns.description: City of the owner's mailing address.

columns.name: state
columns.description: Two-letter US state code of the owner's mailing address.

columns.name: zip_code
columns.description: 5-digit US ZIP code of the owner's mailing address. Stored as text to preserve leading zeros.

columns.name: credit_score
columns.description: Owner's credit-based insurance score (300-850). Used as a rating factor for premium calculation.

columns.name: customer_since
columns.description: Date the owner first became a customer of the insurer (YYYY-MM-DD).
